tasks.label: Run Build
args: $source = '${workspaceFolder}'; $project = (& wsl.exe wslpath -w $source | Out-String).Trim(); if (-not $project) { throw 'Projektpfad konnte nicht ermittelt werden.' }; & wsl.exe bash -lc "source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd '$source' && npm run build"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Frontend-Build fehlgeschlagen.' }; $runningBridge = Get-Process -Name latexhelper-bridge -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($runningBridge) { $runningBridge | Stop-Process -Force; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500 }; $target = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'LatexHelper\target'; cargo build --manifest-path "$project\bridge\Cargo.toml" --target-dir $target --release --locked; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Bridge-Build fehlgeschlagen.' }; $env:LATEXHELPER_DIST = "$project\dist"; Start-Process "$target\release\latexhelper-bridge.exe"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Start-Process "http://localhost:38471/?reload=$([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds())"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $keyboard = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $keyboard.SendKeys('^{F5}'); exit 0
